mapper.sql: select s.sequence_id, s.sequence_code, s.sequence_name, s.enroll_event, s.inactive_days, s.status, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time, s.remark, (select count(*) from abr_nurture_enrollment e where e.sequence_id = s.sequence_id and e.status = 'active') as active_count, (select count(*) from abr_nurture_enrollment e where e.sequence_id = s.sequence_id and e.status = 'waiting_confirm') as waiting_count from abr_nurture_sequence s
mapper.select: select count(*) from abr_nurture_sequence where sequence_code = #{sequenceCode} and sequence_id <> #{sequenceId}
mapper.insert: insert into abr_nurture_sequence (sequence_code, sequence_name, enroll_event, inactive_days, status, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{sequenceCode}, #{sequenceName}, #{enrollEvent}, #{inactiveDays}, #{status}, #{createBy}, now(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update abr_nurture_sequence set sequence_code = #{sequenceCode}, sequence_name = #{sequenceName}, enroll_event = #{enrollEvent}, inactive_days = #{inactiveDays}, status = #{status}, remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where sequence_id = #{sequenceId}
mapper.select: select step_id, sequence_id, step_no, step_name, delay_days, send_hour, template_code, condition_code, cast(playbook_codes as text) as playbook_codes, status, remark from abr_nurture_step where sequence_id = #{sequenceId} order by step_no
mapper.insert: insert into abr_nurture_step (sequence_id, step_no, step_name, delay_days, send_hour, template_code, condition_code, playbook_codes, status, remark) values (#{sequenceId}, #{stepNo}, #{stepName}, #{delayDays}, #{sendHour}, #{templateCode}, #{conditionCode}, cast(#{playbookCodes} as jsonb), #{status}, #{remark})

insert into abr_nurture_enrollment (sequence_id, target_type, target_id, next_step_no, next_due_time, status, enrolled_time, update_time) values (#{sequenceId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{nextStepNo}, #{nextDueTime}, #{status}, #{enrolledTime}, now()) on conflict (sequence_id, target_type, target_id) do nothing
mapper.sql: select e.enrollment_id, e.sequence_id, s.sequence_code, s.sequence_name, e.target_type, e.target_id, case when e.target_type = 'lead' then (select l.display_name from abr_lead l where l.lead_id = e.target_id) end as target_name, e.next_step_no, (select t.step_name from abr_nurture_step t where t.sequence_id = e.sequence_id and t.step_no = e.next_step_no) as next_step_name, e.next_due_time, e.status, e.exit_reason, e.last_result, e.last_sent_time, e.enrolled_time, e.update_time from abr_nurture_enrollment e join abr_nurture_sequence s on s.sequence_id = e.sequence_id
mapper.update: update abr_nurture_enrollment set status = #{status}, next_step_no = #{nextStepNo}, next_due_time = #{nextDueTime}, exit_reason = coalesce(#{exitReason}, ''), last_result = coalesce(#{lastResult}, ''), last_sent_time = coalesce(#{lastSentTime}, last_sent_time), update_time = now() where enrollment_id = #{enrollmentId}

choose.when: with recursive chain(lead_id, merged_into, depth) as ( select lead_id, merged_into, 0 from abr_lead where lead_id = #{targetId} union all select l.lead_id, l.merged_into, c.depth + 1 from abr_lead l join chain c on l.lead_id = c.merged_into where c.depth < 10 ), root as ( select l.* from chain c join abr_lead l on l.lead_id = c.lead_id where c.merged_into is null and l.del_flag = '0' limit 1 ) select r.stage as "stage", r.visitor_id as "visitorId", r.app_user_id as "appUserId", (select count(*) from abr_booking b where b.lead_id = r.lead_id and b.status = 'booked' and b.start_time > now()) as "activeBookings", greatest(r.last_touch_time, (select max(ev.create_time) from abr_event ev where (ev.visitor_id = r.visitor_id or (r.app_user_id is not null and ev.app_user_id = r.app_user_id)) and ev.event_type not in ('plan_moment'))) as "lastActivity" from root r

select null as "stage", u.primary_visitor_id as "visitorId", u.app_user_id as "appUserId", (select count(*) from abr_booking b where b.app_user_id = u.app_user_id and b.status = 'booked' and b.start_time > now()) as "activeBookings", greatest(u.last_login_time, (select max(ev.create_time) from abr_event ev where ev.app_user_id = u.app_user_id)) as "lastActivity" from abr_app_user u where u.app_user_id = #{targetId} and u.del_flag = '0'
choose.otherwise: select null as "stage", v.visitor_id as "visitorId", v.app_user_id as "appUserId", (select count(*) from abr_booking b where b.visitor_id = v.visitor_id and b.status = 'booked' and b.start_time > now()) as "activeBookings", greatest(v.last_seen_time, (select max(ev.create_time) from abr_event ev where ev.visitor_id = v.visitor_id)) as "lastActivity" from abr_visitor v where v.visitor_id = #{targetId}
